registry_metadata.schema:
CREATE TABLE registry_metadata (
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT NOT NULL
)

channels.schema:
CREATE TABLE channels (
  canonical_channel_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  channel_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  current_handle TEXT,
  canonical_url TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  source_group TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_group IN ('STANDARD_PACKAGE','HISTORICAL_CATALOG','IDENTITY_ONLY')),
  target_group TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_group IN ('ORIGINAL_TARGET','ADDED_TARGET','OUTSIDE_TARGET')),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN (
    'COMPLETE','COMPLETE_WITH_LIMITATIONS','PARTIAL',
    'IDENTITY_VERIFIED_DATA_NOT_EXTRACTED','PENDING_IDENTITY_RESOLUTION',
    'UNAVAILABLE_OR_DELETED'
  )),
  completed_tick TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (completed_tick IN ('','✓')),
  identity_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (identity_status IN ('VERIFIED','UNRESOLVED','UNAVAILABLE')),
  extraction_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (extraction_status IN ('COMPLETE','COMPLETE_WITH_LIMITATIONS','PARTIAL','NOT_EXTRACTED')),
  package_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (package_status IN ('STANDARD_PACKAGE','HISTORICAL_FORMAT','NO_PACKAGE')),
  video_metadata_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (video_metadata_status IN ('COMPLETE','COMPLETE_WITH_LIMITATIONS','PARTIAL','NONE')),
  description_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (description_status IN ('COMPLETE','PARTIAL','NONE')),
  transcript_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (transcript_status IN ('COMPLETE_REAL','COMPLETE_WITH_PLACEHOLDERS','PARTIAL','NONE')),
  thumbnail_metadata_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (thumbnail_metadata_status IN ('COMPLETE','PARTIAL','NONE')),
  visual_asset_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (visual_asset_status IN ('NONE','THUMBNAIL_URL_ONLY','THUMBNAIL_EVIDENCE','FORENSIC_VIDEO_EVIDENCE')),
  forensic_video_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (forensic_video_status IN ('AVAILABLE_WITH_LIMITATIONS','NOT_AVAILABLE')),
  intelligence_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (intelligence_status IN ('VALIDATED','AVAILABLE','PARTIAL','DATA_READY','NOT_AVAILABLE','NOT_APPLICABLE')),
  first_party_analytics_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (first_party_analytics_status IN ('INGESTED','SCHEMA_READY_NO_DATA','NOT_CONFIGURED')),
  identity_verified_at TEXT,
  identity_evidence_source TEXT NOT NULL,
  handle_unavailable_reason TEXT,
  limitations TEXT
)

channel_data_layers.schema:
CREATE TABLE channel_data_layers (
  canonical_channel_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES channels(canonical_channel_id),
  layer_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (layer_name IN (
    'identity_status','extraction_status','package_status','video_metadata_status',
    'description_status','transcript_status','thumbnail_metadata_status',
    'visual_asset_status','forensic_video_status','intelligence_status',
    'first_party_analytics_status'
  )),
  status TEXT NOT NULL,
  evidence_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  limitation_reason TEXT,
  last_verified_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(canonical_channel_id,layer_name)
)

submissions.schema:
CREATE TABLE submissions (
  global_row INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  batch TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (batch IN ('A','B')),
  batch_row INTEGER NOT NULL,
  original_url TEXT NOT NULL,
  normalized_url TEXT NOT NULL,
  is_exact_duplicate INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_exact_duplicate IN (0,1)),
  duplicate_of_global_row INTEGER REFERENCES submissions(global_row),
  canonical_channel_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES channels(canonical_channel_id),
  identity_status TEXT NOT NULL,
  evidence_source TEXT NOT NULL,
  verified_at TEXT,
  UNIQUE(batch,batch_row)
)

channel_aliases.schema:
CREATE TABLE channel_aliases (
  alias_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  canonical_channel_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES channels(canonical_channel_id),
  alias_url TEXT NOT NULL,
  alias_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  submission_global_row INTEGER REFERENCES submissions(global_row),
  UNIQUE(canonical_channel_id,alias_url,submission_global_row)
)

identity_evidence.schema:
CREATE TABLE identity_evidence (
  evidence_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  canonical_channel_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES channels(canonical_channel_id),
  source_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_locator TEXT NOT NULL,
  verified_at TEXT,
  observed_name TEXT,
  observed_handle TEXT,
  raw_json TEXT,
  UNIQUE(canonical_channel_id,source_type,source_locator)
)

datasets.schema:
CREATE TABLE datasets (
  dataset_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  dataset_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  manifest_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  evidence_scope TEXT,
  limitations TEXT
)

dataset_channels.schema:
CREATE TABLE dataset_channels (

actor_runs.schema:
CREATE TABLE actor_runs (
  actor_run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  actor_dataset_id TEXT,
  dataset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),

videos.schema:
CREATE TABLE videos (
  youtube_video_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  canonical_channel_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES channels(canonical_channel_id),
  canonical_url TEXT NOT NULL,
  title TEXT,
  published_at TEXT,

dataset_videos.schema:

)

transcripts.schema:
CREATE TABLE transcripts (
  transcript_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  youtube_video_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES videos(youtube_video_id),
  dataset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),

subtitle_tracks.schema:
CREATE TABLE subtitle_tracks (
  subtitle_track_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  youtube_video_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES videos(youtube_video_id),
  dataset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),

artifacts.schema:
CREATE TABLE artifacts (
  artifact_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  dataset_id TEXT REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),
  canonical_channel_id TEXT REFERENCES channels(canonical_channel_id),
  artifact_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  repository_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  sha256 TEXT,
  availability_status TEXT NOT NULL,
  unavailable_reason TEXT,
  UNIQUE(dataset_id,canonical_channel_id,artifact_type,repository_path)
)

availability_gaps.schema:
CREATE TABLE availability_gaps (
  gap_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  canonical_channel_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES channels(canonical_channel_id),
  field_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  unavailable_reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  evidence_source TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(canonical_channel_id,field_name,unavailable_reason)
)

intelligence_capabilities.schema:
CREATE TABLE intelligence_capabilities (
  capability_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  capability_name TEXT NOT NULL
)

intelligence_coverage.schema:
CREATE TABLE intelligence_coverage (
  canonical_channel_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES channels(canonical_channel_id),
  capability_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES intelligence_capabilities(capability_id),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('VALIDATED','AVAILABLE','PARTIAL','DATA_READY','NOT_AVAILABLE','NOT_APPLICABLE')),
  input_data_available INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (input_data_available IN (0,1)),
  generated_artifact_available INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generated_artifact_available IN (0,1)),
  evidence_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  limitation_reason TEXT,
  last_verified_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(canonical_channel_id,capability_id)
)

visual_coverage.schema:
CREATE TABLE visual_coverage (
  canonical_channel_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES channels(canonical_channel_id),
  thumbnail_url_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (thumbnail_url_count >= 0),
  downloaded_thumbnail_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (downloaded_thumbnail_count >= 0),
  screenshot_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (screenshot_count >= 0),
  keyframe_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (keyframe_count >= 0),
  registered_source_video_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (registered_source_video_count >= 0),
  timestamped_visual_observation_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (timestamped_visual_observation_count >= 0),
  visual_evidence_level TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (visual_evidence_level IN ('NONE','THUMBNAIL_URL_ONLY','THUMBNAIL_EVIDENCE','FORENSIC_VIDEO_EVIDENCE')),
  editing_visual_intelligence_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (editing_visual_intelligence_status IN ('PARTIAL','NOT_AVAILABLE')),
  evidence_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  limitation_reason TEXT
)

non_channel_subjects.schema:
CREATE TABLE non_channel_subjects (
  subject_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  subject_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  canonical_channel_id TEXT,

)

subject_datasets.schema:
CREATE TABLE subject_datasets (
  subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES non_channel_subjects(subject_id),
  dataset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),

)

schema_meta.schema:
CREATE TABLE schema_meta (

    applied_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
    description     TEXT NOT NULL
)

datasets.schema:
CREATE TABLE datasets (
    dataset_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    dataset_name    TEXT NOT NULL,
    semantic_class  TEXT NOT NULL,
    description     TEXT,
    source_type     TEXT NOT NULL,
    ingestion_mode  TEXT NOT NULL,
    status          TEXT NOT NULL,
    discovered_as   TEXT,
    date_received   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes           TEXT
)

ingestion_runs.schema:
CREATE TABLE ingestion_runs (
    run_id                TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    dataset_id            TEXT REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),
    started_at            TEXT NOT NULL,
    completed_at          TEXT,
    status                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('STARTED', 'COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'ROLLED_BACK')),
    source_file_count     INTEGER,
    archive_member_count  INTEGER,
    total_size_bytes      INTEGER,
    errors_count          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    verification_status   TEXT,
    tool_version          TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes                 TEXT
, run_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'FILE_INGESTION'
    CHECK (run_type IN ('FILE_INGESTION', 'STRUCTURED_REGISTRATION')))

source_locations.schema:
CREATE TABLE source_locations (
    source_location_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    dataset_id           TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),
    original_path        TEXT NOT NULL,
    location_type         TEXT NOT NULL,
    exists_at_ingestion   INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (exists_at_ingestion IN (0, 1)),
    observed_at            TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes                  TEXT
)

source_files.schema:
CREATE TABLE source_files (
    file_id               TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    dataset_id            TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),
    ingestion_run_id      TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ingestion_runs(run_id),
    parent_file_id        TEXT REFERENCES source_files(file_id),

    storage_kind          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (storage_kind IN ('PHYSICAL_FILE', 'ARCHIVE_MEMBER')),
    file_role             TEXT NOT NULL,

    original_filename     TEXT NOT NULL,
    original_path         TEXT NOT NULL,
    relative_path         TEXT,

    canonical_path        TEXT,
    archive_member_path   TEXT,

    extension             TEXT,
    mime_type              TEXT,

    size_bytes             INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sha256                 TEXT,

    semantic_class          TEXT,
    evidence_layer           TEXT,

    is_copied                INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_copied IN (0, 1)),
    is_archive_member         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_archive_member IN (0, 1)),

    processing_status          TEXT NOT NULL,
    verification_status        TEXT NOT NULL,

    created_at                  TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes                        TEXT
)

file_relationships.schema:
CREATE TABLE file_relationships (
    relationship_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    from_file_id        TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_files(file_id),
    to_file_id           TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_files(file_id),
    relationship_type     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (relationship_type IN (
        'EXACT_DUPLICATE_OF', 'PROBABLE_DUPLICATE_OF', 'REVISION_OF',
        'ARCHIVE_OF', 'CONTAINS', 'DERIVED_FROM', 'SUPERSEDES', 'RELATED_TO'
    )),
    confidence             TEXT,
    evidence                TEXT,
    created_at                TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes                      TEXT
)

ingestion_errors.schema:
CREATE TABLE ingestion_errors (
    error_id                 TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id                    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ingestion_runs(run_id),
    dataset_id                TEXT REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),
    file_id                    TEXT REFERENCES source_files(file_id),
    error_type                  TEXT NOT NULL,
    severity                     TEXT NOT NULL,
    message                       TEXT NOT NULL,
    retryable                      INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (retryable IN (0, 1)),
    requires_human_review           INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (requires_human_review IN (0, 1)),
    created_at                       TEXT NOT NULL,
    resolved_at                       TEXT,
    notes                              TEXT
)

channels.schema:
CREATE TABLE channels (
    channel_id                TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    youtube_channel_id        TEXT UNIQUE,
    handle                    TEXT,
    display_name              TEXT NOT NULL,
    channel_url               TEXT,
    created_from_dataset_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),
    created_at                TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at                TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes                     TEXT
)

channel_snapshots.schema:
CREATE TABLE channel_snapshots (
    channel_snapshot_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    channel_id                TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES channels(channel_id),
    dataset_id                TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),
    registration_run_id       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ingestion_runs(run_id),
    observed_at                TEXT NOT NULL,
    subscriber_count           INTEGER,
    video_count                 INTEGER,
    created_at                   TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes                         TEXT,
    UNIQUE (channel_id, dataset_id, observed_at)
)

videos.schema:
CREATE TABLE videos (
    video_id                  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    youtube_video_id          TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    channel_id                TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES channels(channel_id),
    canonical_url              TEXT,
    created_from_dataset_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),
    created_at                  TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at                   TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes                         TEXT
)

video_snapshots.schema:
CREATE TABLE video_snapshots (
    video_snapshot_id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    video_id                   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES videos(video_id),
    dataset_id                  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),
    registration_run_id          TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ingestion_runs(run_id),

    observed_at                    TEXT NOT NULL,
    published_at                    TEXT,

    title                             TEXT,
    duration_seconds                   INTEGER,

    views                                INTEGER,
    likes                                 INTEGER,
    comments                              INTEGER,

    views_per_day                          REAL,
    engagement_rate                         REAL,

    description_char_count                   INTEGER,
    transcript_word_count                     INTEGER,

    created_at                                 TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes                                        TEXT, description TEXT, video_type TEXT, thumbnail_url TEXT,
    UNIQUE (video_id, dataset_id, observed_at)
)

transcripts.schema:
CREATE TABLE transcripts (
    transcript_id               TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    video_id                    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES videos(video_id),
    dataset_id                   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),
    registration_run_id           TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ingestion_runs(run_id),

    archive_member_file_id          TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_files(file_id),

    availability_status               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (availability_status IN ('AVAILABLE', 'UNAVAILABLE')),
    caption_type                        TEXT,
    language                             TEXT,
    word_count                            INTEGER,

    transcript_sha256                      TEXT,
    description_present                     INTEGER CHECK (description_present IN (0, 1)),

    created_at                                TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes                                       TEXT, transcript_format TEXT, transcript_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SUPPLIED_ARCHIVE', canonical_reference TEXT, timing_quality TEXT CHECK (
    timing_quality IN ('EXACT_TIMESTAMPED', 'SEGMENT_TIMESTAMPED', 'POSITIONAL_ONLY', 'INSUFFICIENT_TIMING')
),
    UNIQUE (video_id, dataset_id, registration_run_id)
)

field_provenance.schema:
CREATE TABLE field_provenance (
    provenance_id                TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

    dataset_id                    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),
    registration_run_id             TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ingestion_runs(run_id),
    source_file_id                    TEXT REFERENCES source_files(file_id),

    channel_id                          TEXT REFERENCES channels(channel_id),
    channel_snapshot_id                   TEXT REFERENCES channel_snapshots(channel_snapshot_id),
    video_id                                TEXT REFERENCES videos(video_id),
    video_snapshot_id                         TEXT REFERENCES video_snapshots(video_snapshot_id),
    transcript_id                               TEXT REFERENCES transcripts(transcript_id),

    field_name                                    TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_locator                                  TEXT NOT NULL,

    value_origin                                      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (value_origin IN (
        'SOURCE_EXTRACTED', 'SOURCE_DECLARED', 'SOURCE_COMPUTED',
        'TRANSCRIPT_METADATA', 'ARCHIVE_OBSERVED', 'SYSTEM_VERIFIED'
    )),
    evidence_layer                                      TEXT NOT NULL,
    extraction_method                                     TEXT,

    observed_at                                             TEXT,
    created_at                                                TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes                                                       TEXT,

    CHECK (
        (CASE WHEN channel_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN channel_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN video_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN video_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN transcript_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
    )
)

source_batches.schema:
CREATE TABLE source_batches (
    batch_id        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    batch_name      TEXT NOT NULL,
    started_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
    completed_at    TEXT,
    status          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('STARTED', 'COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED')),
    root_count      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    tool_version    TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes           TEXT
)

batch_roots.schema:
CREATE TABLE batch_roots (
    batch_root_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    batch_id            TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_batches(batch_id),
    root_index          INTEGER NOT NULL,
    supplied_path        TEXT NOT NULL,
    canonical_path        TEXT,
    exists_at_discovery    INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (exists_at_discovery IN (0, 1)),
    root_type               TEXT,
    file_count                INTEGER,
    dir_count                  INTEGER,
    symlink_count                INTEGER,
    total_size_bytes               INTEGER,
    observed_at                     TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes                            TEXT,
    UNIQUE (batch_id, root_index)
)

discovered_files.schema:
CREATE TABLE discovered_files (
    discovered_file_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    batch_id              TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_batches(batch_id),
    batch_root_id          TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES batch_roots(batch_root_id),

    entry_type               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entry_type IN ('FILE', 'DIR', 'SYMLINK', 'OTHER')),
    absolute_path              TEXT NOT NULL,
    relative_path                TEXT NOT NULL,

    extension                     TEXT,
    mime_type                      TEXT,
    size_bytes                      INTEGER,
    sha256                           TEXT,

    dataset_id                       TEXT REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),
    source_file_id                    TEXT REFERENCES source_files(file_id),

    disposition                        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (disposition IN (
        'INGEST', 'REFERENCE_ONLY', 'ALREADY_INGESTED', 'EXACT_DUPLICATE',
        'NEAR_DUPLICATE', 'REVISION', 'SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE', 'SUPERSEDED',
        'NOISE', 'TOOLING', 'UNSUPPORTED', 'UNSAFE', 'HOLD'
    )),
    disposition_reason                  TEXT NOT NULL,
    duplicate_of_discovered_file_id       TEXT REFERENCES discovered_files(discovered_file_id),

    processing_status                      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RECORDED',
    created_at                              TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes                                     TEXT
)

visual_assets.schema:
CREATE TABLE visual_assets (
    visual_asset_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    discovered_file_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES discovered_files(discovered_file_id),
    dataset_id             TEXT REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),

    sha256                   TEXT NOT NULL,
    width_px                  INTEGER,
    height_px                  INTEGER,
    color_mode                  TEXT,
    image_format                  TEXT,
    orientation                     TEXT,
    exif_json                         TEXT,

    perceptual_hash                     TEXT,
    perceptual_hash_algorithm             TEXT,

    frame_sequence_id                       TEXT,
    frame_index                              INTEGER,
    visual_state_cluster_id                    TEXT,

    created_at                                  TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes                                         TEXT
)

visual_observations.schema:
CREATE TABLE visual_observations (
    visual_observation_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    visual_asset_id           TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES visual_assets(visual_asset_id),

    observation_type            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (observation_type IN ('OCR', 'SEMANTIC_INSPECTION')),
    observation_method             TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_surface                   TEXT,

    extracted_text                     TEXT,
    confidence                           REAL,
    structured_json                        TEXT,

entity_classifications.schema:
CREATE TABLE entity_classifications (
    classification_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    dataset_id              TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),
    target_type               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_type IN ('DATASET', 'CHANNEL', 'VIDEO')),
    target_ref                  TEXT NOT NULL,

    content_domain                 TEXT,
    sub_niche                        TEXT,
    target_audience                    TEXT,
    content_format                       TEXT,
    packaging_style                        TEXT,
    thumbnail_style                          TEXT,
    presenter_style                            TEXT,
    editing_style                                TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN',

    source_locator                                    TEXT NOT NULL,

document_records.schema:
CREATE TABLE document_records (
    document_id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    discovered_file_id       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES discovered_files(discovered_file_id),
    dataset_id                 TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),

    title                         TEXT,
    document_type                   TEXT,
    subject                           TEXT,
    knowledge_domains                  TEXT,
    evidence_type                        TEXT NOT NULL,
    authorship                             TEXT,
    ai_generated_indicators                  TEXT,
    relationship_notes                         TEXT,
    priority                                     TEXT,
    revision_status                                TEXT,

    content_read                                    INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (content_read IN (0, 1)),
    created_at                                        TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes                                               TEXT
)

apify_source_runs.schema:
CREATE TABLE apify_source_runs (
    apify_source_run_id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    registration_run_id          TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES ingestion_runs(run_id),
    dataset_id                   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),

    actor_name                   TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor_id                     TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor_run_id                 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    actor_build_id               TEXT,
    actor_build_number           TEXT,
    actor_build_version          TEXT,

    started_at                   TEXT NOT NULL,
    finished_at                  TEXT,
    observed_at                  TEXT NOT NULL,
    input_json                   TEXT NOT NULL,

    run_status                   TEXT NOT NULL,

channel_dataset_links.schema:
CREATE TABLE channel_dataset_links (
    channel_id          TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES channels(channel_id),
    dataset_id          TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),
    relationship_type   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (relationship_type IN (
        'CREATED_FROM', 'IDENTITY_EVIDENCE', 'STRUCTURED_OBSERVATION'
    )),
    source_locator      TEXT NOT NULL,
    evidence_layer      TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at          TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes               TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (channel_id, dataset_id, relationship_type)
)

apify_result_records.schema:
CREATE TABLE apify_result_records (
    apify_result_record_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    apify_source_run_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES apify_source_runs(apify_source_run_id),
    video_id                TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES videos(video_id),
    record_index            INTEGER NOT NULL,
    raw_record_sha256       TEXT NOT NULL,
    observed_at             TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at              TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (apify_source_run_id, video_id),
    UNIQUE (apify_source_run_id, record_index)
)

thumbnail_evidence.schema:
CREATE TABLE thumbnail_evidence (
    thumbnail_evidence_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    video_id                TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES videos(video_id),
    dataset_id              TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),
    registration_run_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ingestion_runs(run_id),
    apify_source_run_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES apify_source_runs(apify_source_run_id),
    thumbnail_url           TEXT NOT NULL,
    source                  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source = 'APIFY'),
    extraction_provider     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (extraction_provider = 'streamers/youtube-scraper'),
    extraction_method       TEXT NOT NULL,
    observed_at             TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at              TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (video_id, apify_source_run_id, thumbnail_url)
)

apify_run_cost_observations.schema:
CREATE TABLE apify_run_cost_observations (
    cost_observation_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    apify_source_run_id       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES apify_source_runs(apify_source_run_id),
    observed_at               TEXT NOT NULL,
    usage_total_usd           REAL NOT NULL,
    charged_event_counts_json TEXT,
    event_usage_json          TEXT,
    is_final                  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_final IN (0, 1)),
    source_locator            TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at                TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes                     TEXT
)

dataset_relationships.schema:
CREATE TABLE dataset_relationships (
    relationship_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    from_dataset_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),
    to_dataset_id       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),
    relationship_type    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (relationship_type IN (
        'SAME_SOURCE_INDEPENDENT_ANALYSIS', 'REVISION_OF',
        'DUPLICATE_DATASET', 'RELATED_BUT_UNRESOLVED'
    )),
    confidence            TEXT NOT NULL,
    status                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PROVEN', 'UNRESOLVED')),
    evidence               TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_locator         TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at             TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes                  TEXT,
    CHECK (from_dataset_id <> to_dataset_id),
    UNIQUE (from_dataset_id, to_dataset_id, relationship_type)
)

content_classifications.schema:
CREATE TABLE content_classifications (
    classification_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    video_id                TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES videos(video_id),
    dataset_id              TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(dataset_id),
    source_file_id          TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_files(file_id),

    classification_dimension TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
        classification_dimension IN ('CONTENT_TOPIC', 'CONTENT_FORMAT')
    ),
    classification_value    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(classification_value)) > 0),
    evidence_layer          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (evidence_layer IN (
        'EXTRACTED_FACT', 'MEASURED_FACT', 'OBSERVATION',
        'AI_INTERPRETATION', 'HUMAN_INTERPRETATION'
    )),
    classification_status   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (classification_status IN (
        'PROPOSED', 'VERIFIED', 'REJECTED', 'SUPERSEDED'
    )),

    source_locator          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(source_locator)) > 0),
    classification_method   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(classification_method)) > 0),
    method_version          TEXT,
    reproducibility_status  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
        reproducibility_status IN ('REPRODUCIBLE', 'NON_REPRODUCIBLE')
    ),
    created_at              TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes                   TEXT,

    CHECK (
        reproducibility_status = 'NON_REPRODUCIBLE'
        OR length(trim(method_version)) > 0
    )
)
